How city trees improve everyday life

Urban trees cool streets, support wildlife, and make public spaces more comfortable.

Cooling streets and homes

Tree canopies provide shade and reduce the amount of heat absorbed by roads and buildings.

Neighborhoods with continuous canopy cover can offer more comfortable walking routes during summer.

Planning a resilient canopy

Cities should select diverse native species and provide enough soil and water for healthy roots.

  • Plant several species instead of relying on a single variety.
  • Protect young trees while construction work is taking place.
